metadata.source_note: Official final 2026 Virginia Form 760ES. The extracted Tax Rate Schedule provides the 2%, 3%, 5%, and 5.75% Virginia taxable-income brackets for estimating 2026 individual income tax. This source does not establish final Form 760 resident-return liability, taxable-income construction, deductions, credits, spouse tax adjustment, part-year allocation, withholding, underpayment additions, or final-return ordering.
